{{dablink|For other uses of the word "heart," see [[Heart (disambiguation)|Heart]].}}
A '''heart''' is a collection of three [[Black Ajah]] sisters, who work in isolation. Each sister in a heart will also have contact with one sister in another heart, of whom the other two sisters will be unaware.{{ref/book|10|p}}

Only two hearts have been identified:
* [[Atuan Larisett]], [[Karale Sanghir]], [[Marris Thornhill]]
* [[Galina Casban]], [[Talene Minly]], [[Temaile Kinderode]]
